t: You're in Queen's Road Cemetery in Walthamstow. Buried here is Jack Williams, whose full name was John Edward Williams. He was born in 1854 and was a British socialist, active in the unemployed movement. The material I have about him is brief, so I won't claim more than that. If you're walking the cemetery, he's one of the figures who ties this quiet corner of Walthamstow to the early history of socialist politics in Britain.
